feeds.title: Adoptee Rights Law Center Blog
feeds.description: Read thoughts, updates, and legal developments in advancing the rights of adult adoptees. Gregory D. Luce is a Minnesota-based attorney and a DC-born adoptee. He is the founder of Adoptee Rights Law Center and the president of Adoptees United Inc. He helps adult adopted people navigate legal challenges in obtaining their own original birth certificates, securing U.S. citizenship, and seeking information to which they are entitled.

feeds.title: InterCountry Adoptee Voices
feeds.description: ICAV provides a platform for adoptees to connect in, share, educate, and advocate to the wider public about the issues we face - political, social, and emotional, including the not-so-positive aspects of intercountry adoption.

feeds.title: American Indian Adoptees Blog
feeds.description: A blog by and about American Indian Adoptees, Split Feathers, Lost Children of the Indian Adoption Projects. We've amassed tons of information and important history on this blog since 2010.

feeds.title: Abrazo Blog
feeds.description: Adoption blog covers articles on adoptive parents, birth parents, adoptee and general adoption topics. Abrazo Adoption Associates is a private, nonprofit adoption agency serving the needs of birth parents, children, and adopting parents nationwide.

feeds.title: Adoptee Voices Blog
feeds.description: Sara Easterly is an award-winning author of books and essays. For Adoptee Voices, Sara leverages her experience leading one of the largest chapters of the Society of Children's Book Writers & Illustrations (SCBWI) as well as her background in author publicity supporting multiple New York Times best-selling authors and their publishers.

feeds.title: My Adoptee Truth Blog
feeds.description: My Adoptee Truth Blog shares my journey through adoption trauma and creates a safe space for other adoptees to share their truths. I am an adult adoptee, born in 1979 and adopted through a religious organization in a closed adoption.

feeds.title: The Adopted Ones Blog
feeds.description: The Adopted Ones Blog shares insights of two adoptees, one vocal and the other not so much.

feeds.title: KAAN Blog
feeds.description: KAAN was founded in 1998 to build a national Korean adoption community with adoptees at its center. We seek to better understand and improve the lives of adoptees and their families through our conferences and other services. Visit their blog stories from the KAAN Community and the latest KAAN news.

feeds.title: Akin to the Truth: A Memoir of Adoption and Identity
feeds.description: Akin to the Truth: A Memoir of Adoption and Identity Blog pens down the journey of adoptees, reviews books, documentaries, movies, and more related to the subject, and shines the light on life.

feeds.title: Adoption: My Truth
feeds.description: My name is Laureen Pittman. I'm a happily married wife and mother of two great boys. I'm adopted. I'm sharing my journey in search of my truth. I'm turning 50 this year. This blog is about me and my adoption story.

feeds.title: Forbidden Family
feeds.description: Doris Michol Sippel is an American civil rights activist fighting for the freedom of 7 to 10 million domestic-and-foreign-born adopted and donor-conceived people. Doris promotes family preservation, kinship care, and custodial guardianship as better alternatives to adoption.

feeds.title: Adoptee Bridge Blog
feeds.description: AdopteeBridge is a not-for-profit organization that delivers education, resources, and services to the community related to the topics of transnational and transracial adoption. We offer positive, support services to these adoptees empowering them to have a better understanding of their identity, birthland, and adoption story.

feeds.title: Diary of a Not-So-Angry Asian Adoptee
feeds.description: My name is Christina Romo, and I am a Korean adoptee. Diary of a Not-So-Angry Asian Adoptee is a place where I share openly about my journey as an adoptee, a mom, an adoption professional, and an advocate along with the issues that I am passionate about and inspire me to write.

feeds.title: Unfolding Adoptees Blog
feeds.description: Unfolding Adoptees provides Christian adult adoptees with an honest community in which they tell their stories to share encouragement and insight that is grounded in Biblical truth and Christlike love.

feeds.title: Adoptee LIT Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Stephanie M. Oyler. As both an Adoptee and an Adoption professional I come with a unique set of skills and perspectives in understanding and navigating the Adoption world. This blog serves as the stepping stone to the work I hope to continue and expand upon.

feeds.title: Black Sheep Sweet Dreams
feeds.description: Black Sheep Sweet Dreams blog is designed to share a personal journey that has recently proven to be the most amazing roller-coaster of my entire life. My blog is a resource for people who want to trace their birth parents, in particular birth mothers.
